literatureGoals.population: 40 shoulders of 20 volunteers without shoulder problems
literatureGoals.citation: Namdari S, Yagnik G, Ebaugh DD, Nagda S, Ramsey ML, Williams GR, Mehta S. Defining functional shoulder range of motion for activities of daily living. J Shoulder Elbow Surg. 2012;21(9):1177-1183. Ten daily tasks needed 121 +/- 6.7 deg of flexion; the authors still call full motion a reasonable goal.

notes: Side view keeps forward arm elevation (sagittal plane) in the image plane. KIMORE Es1 (arm lift) moves mostly forward; on KIMORE skeletons projected to a side-on phone the range error was 0.7 deg median against a goniometer-style in-plane angle (docs/kimore-study.md). The patient turns the side to be measured toward the camera.
